theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
  let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
  let r' := r ^ k / ↑k.factorial
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_div_pow_at_top_of_tendsto_mul_pow_div_factorial (by simp) (by simp)
  have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds r ^ k) :=
    tendsto_pow_const h1
  have h4 : Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds r') :=
    tendsto_mul h2 h3
  exact h4
